text:
maria: heads-up — link-checker just flagged a redirect loop on the KB page /runtime/snippets. looks like an inline snippet references `short://abc123` which 302s back to the kb and creates a loop. who owns that page?

link-checker-bot: scan result: 1 redirect loop detected on /runtime/snippets. trace: https://kb.redwood.ai/runtime/snippets -> short://abc123 -> https://cdn.redwood.ai/c/xyz -> https://kb.redwood.ai/runtime/snippets (301/302)

alex: hm. i remember we copied a marketing shortlink into that snippet ages ago. not sure who owns the snippet now — docs or marketing?

kevin: i can do a quick PR to replace the shortlink with a canonical internal url. prefer `https://kb.redwood.ai/runtime/snippets#inline-snippets` unless someone objects. also saw link-checker called out a missing alt on one of the images on the same page.

maria: sounds good. can you put both fixes in one PR? replacing the shortlink and adding missing alt text would be ideal.

sre-jen: fyi the CDN can cache redirects; if the shortlink has been hit recently the loop may persist until invalidation. after the PR, we'll need a CDN invalidation. i'll coordinate.

kevin: will do. i'll open a small PR. also running a quick repro with curl to show the loop:
```
curl -I https://short.example/abc123
```
shows 302 -> cdn -> 301 -> kb (repeat).

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12345 by kevin — requested reviewers @maria @alex

alex: i'll review later today. cc @jordan from marketing — can you confirm whether `short://abc123` is still used in any templates? if so we should retire it to avoid future reintroductions.

jordan: marketing here — that shortlink is referenced in one old onboarding email. i'll update the template and replace it with the canonical KB link by EOD.

maria: great, thanks. kevin — after you merge and we invalidate CDN can you paste the final resolved url here so i can mark the issue resolved in the tracker? :thumbsup:

kevin: merged and invalidation scheduled. final URL used: https://kb.redwood.ai/runtime/snippets#inline-snippets

docs-bot: link-checker-bot re-scan passed for /runtime/snippets at 2026-03-17T15:45Z

sre-jen: closing the loop — added a note to the ops runbook to scan for shortlink -> cdn -> kb redirect patterns during weekly checks.

maria: thanks everyone, nice quick coordinated fix.
